## Talk

Invited talk in the [Lunch & Learn Open Science](https://www.zb.uzh.ch/de/events/lunch-learn-public-open-review-in-practice-experiences-from-the-living-handbook-discrimination-sensitive-metadata-practice) series at the Zentralbibliothek Zürich (online, 2026-08-27).

## Abstract

The talk presents findings from a completed public open review of the second edition of the [Handbuch zur Erstellung diskriminierungsfreier Metadaten](/products/publications/handbuch/index.qmd), now titled *[Diskriminierungssensible Metadatenpraxis](https://moritz-maehr.quarto.pub/diskriminierungssensible-metadatenpraxis/)*. It compares this open-review approach with the closed peer review used for the first edition, and discusses governance, quality assurance, community feedback processes, versioning, and alignment with the FAIR and CARE principles.
